title: Blank flash (fully erased)

setup.describe: Erase the ENTIRE flash (foreground — a backgrounded espflash has died silently mid-write before)

manual: Click Connect and pick this board's port in Chrome's chooser.
Wait for the card to settle — it should read as blank flash / needs firmware.

emulated.note: `espflash erase-flash` has no emulated form and needs none: a blank board is a `kind=rom-up` board whose flash file was never written, on a state dir this run just created. That IS the erased chip — the mask ROM finds no image at the reset vector and loops `invalid header: 0xffffffff`, which is what the classifier reads.

steps.describe: Click Connect and pick this board in the in-page chooser.
Wait for the card to settle — it should read as blank flash / needs firmware.

The classifier's verdict reaches the trace. LAST on purpose: this is the spec's own `expect`, and everything before it has already been observed, so a failure here is about the TRACE and not about the walk.
